name: @underway/editor
description: No entry point: consumed file by file through the @/editor/* path alias, as editor-ui is. The shared web editor's engine-bound pieces — the long-press radial menu, the tool sheet and popover, grid snap, the resize and rotate maths, the keyboard shortcuts — for Sol, DrawBot and CozyJournal. Unlike @underway/editor-ui it imports the engine freely; what it never imports is an app.
